lints.rule_text: CAs SHALL NOT issue Certificates containing Domain Names that end in an IP Reverse Zone Suffix
`subjectUniqueID` | MUST NOT be present
When multiple `AccessDescription`s are present with the same `accessMethod`, each `accessLocation` MUST be unique
Any other value | - | MUST NOT | - | No other `accessMethod`s may be used.
If present, the Certificate Policies extension MUST contain at least one `PolicyInformation`
Regardless of the order of `PolicyInformation` values, the Certificate Policies extension MUST contain exactly one Reserved Certificate Policy Identifier
`policyQualifiers` are NOT RECOMMENDED to be present
MUST include exactly one Reserved Certificate Policy Identifier (see [Section 7.
`policyQualifiers` are NOT RECOMMENDED to be present
Any other value | - | NOT RECOMMENDED
`minimum` | MUST NOT be present.
| It is NOT RECOMMENDED to include values within `excludedSubtrees`.
`authorityCertSerialNumber` | MUST NOT be present
`authorityCertIssuer` | MUST NOT be present
Root CA Certificates.
`signatureAlgorithm` | Encoded value MUST be byte-for-byte identical to the `tbsCertificate.
`digitalSignature` | Y | SHOULD
`dataEncipherment` | Y | NOT RECOMMENDED
MUST contain at least one `dNSName` or `iPAddress` `GeneralName`
Otherwise, this extension MUST NOT be marked critical

The Fully-Qualified Domain Name or the FQDN portion of the Wildcard Domain Name contained in the entry MUST be composed entirely of P-Labels or Non-Reserved LDH Labels joined together by a U+002E FULL STOP (".

If the `subject` field of the certificate is an empty SEQUENCE, this extension MUST be marked critical, as specified in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.6](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.1.6)
`stateOrProvinceName` | MUST / MAY | MUST be present if `localityName` is absent
`surname` | MUST | The Subject's surname.
`givenName` | MUST | The Subject's given name.
The `domainComponent` fields for the Domain Name MUST be in a single ordered sequence containing all Domain Labels from the Domain Name.
The Domain Labels MUST be encoded in the reverse order to the on-wire representation of domain names in the DNS protocol, so that the Domain Label closest to the root is encoded first.
`stateOrProvinceName` | MUST / MAY | MUST be present if `localityName` is absent
`localityName` MUST be present if stateOrProvinceName is absent, MAY be present otherwise.
`localityName` | MUST / MAY | MUST be present if `stateOrProvinceName` is absent
`postalCode` | NOT RECOMMENDED | If present
`surname` | MUST NOT | - | -
`givenName` | MUST NOT | - | -
`domainComponent` | MAY | If present, this field MUST contain a Domain Label from a Domain Name.
each `accessLocation` MUST be encoded as the specified `GeneralName` type
`pathLenConstraint` | MUST NOT be present
If present, the Certificate Policies extension MUST contain at least one `PolicyInformation`
Regardless of the order of `PolicyInformation` values, the Certificate Policies extension MUST contain exactly one Reserved Certificate Policy Identifier
`anyPolicy` | MUST NOT | The `anyPolicy` Policy Identifier MUST NOT be present.
Any other qualifier | MUST NOT | - | -
`policyQualifiers` are NOT RECOMMENDED to be present
If present, the `AuthorityInfoAccessSyntax` MUST contain one or more `AccessDescription`s
Each `AccessDescription` MUST only contain a permitted `accessMethod`, as detailed below
Any other value | - | MUST NOT | - | No other `accessMethod`s may be used.

Due to DER encoding rules regarding the encoding of DEFAULT values within OPTIONAL fields, a `basicConstraints` extension that sets the `cA` boolean to FALSE MUST have an `extnValue` `OCTET STRING` which is exactly the hex-encoded bytes `3000`, the encoded representation of an empty ASN.
`pathLenConstraint` | MUST NOT be present
Any other value | - | MUST NOT
`anyPolicy` | NOT RECOMMENDED |
Any other qualifier | MUST NOT | - | -
`policyQualifiers` are NOT RECOMMENDED to be present
The CA SHALL indicate an RSA key using the rsaEncryption (OID: 1.2.840.113549.1.1.1) algorithm identifier.
The CA SHALL NOT use a different algorithm, such as the `id-RSASSA-PSS` (OID: 1.2.840.113549.1.1.10) algorithm identifier, to indicate an RSA key
For P-256 keys, the `namedCurve` MUST be `secp256r1` (OID: 1.2.840.10045.3.1.7)
For P-384 keys, the `namedCurve` MUST be `secp384r1` (OID: 1.3.132.0.34)
For P-521 keys, the `namedCurve` MUST be `secp521r1` (OID: 1.3.132.0.35)

When encoded, the AlgorithmIdentifier MUST be byte-for-byte identical with the specified hex-encoded bytes. - RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256: Encoding: 300d06092a864886f70d01010b0500. - RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-384: Encoding: 300d06092a864886f70d01010c0500. - RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-512: Encoding: 300d06092a864886f70d01010d0500. - RSASSA-PSS with SHA-256, MGF-1 with SHA-256, and a salt length of 32 bytes: Encoding: hexdump 304106092a864886f70d01010a3034a00f300d0609608648016503040201 0500a11c301a06092a864886f70d010108300d0609608648016503040201 0500a203020120 - RSASSA-PSS with SHA-384, MGF-1 with SHA-384, and a salt length of 48 bytes: Encoding: hexdump 304106092a864886f70d01010a3034a00f300d0609608648016503040202 0500a11c301a06092a864886f70d010108300d0609608648016503040202 0500a203020130 - RSASSA-PSS with SHA-512, MGF-1 with SHA-512, and a salt length of 64 bytes: Encoding: hexdump 304106092a864886f70d01010a3034a00f300d0609608648016503040203 0500a11c301a06092a864886f70d010108300d0609608648016503040203 0500a203020140
`domainComponent` MUST use IA5String
`stateOrProvinceName` MUST use UTF8String or PrintableString

Specifically, all Domain Labels of the Fully-Qualified Domain Name or FQDN portion of the Wildcard Domain Name must be encoded as LDH Labels, and P-Labels MUST NOT be converted to their Unicode representation

If the value is a Fully-Qualified Domain Name or Wildcard Domain Name, then the value MUST be encoded as a character-for-character copy of the `dNSName` entry value from the `subjectAltName` extension
If the value is an IPv4 address, then the value MUST be encoded as an IPv4Address as specified in [RFC 3986, Section 3.2.2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3986#section-3.2.2)
If present, version MUST be v2 or v3
If present, version MUST be v3
If only basic fields are present, the version SHOULD be 1 (the value is omitted from the certificate as the default value)
When extensions are used, as expected in this profile, version MUST be 3 (value is 2)
CAs MUST force the serialNumber to be a non-negative integer
This field MUST contain the same algorithm identifier as the signatureAlgorithm field in the sequence Certificate (Section 4.
For the purposes of this profile, UTCTime values MUST be expressed in Greenwich Mean Time (Zulu)
the subjectAltName extension MUST be critical
These fields MUST NOT appear if the version is 1
These fields MUST only appear if the version is 2 or 3 (Section 4.
For IPv4 addresses, the iPAddress field of GeneralName MUST contain eight (8) octets, encoded in the style of RFC 4632 (CIDR) to represent an address range [RFC4632]
For IPv6 addresses, the iPAddress field MUST contain 32 octets similarly encoded
That is, either the inhibitPolicyMapping field or the requireExplicitPolicy field MUST be present
Conforming CAs SHOULD use the UTF8String encoding for explicitText
Conforming CAs MUST NOT encode explicitText as VisibleString or BMPString
the subjectAltName extension MUST be present
When including the subjectAltName extension in a certificate that has a non-empty subject distinguished name, conforming CAs SHOULD mark the subjectAltName extension as non-critical
For IP version 4, as specified in [RFC791], the octet string MUST contain exactly four octets
For IP version 6, as specified in [RFC2460], the octet string MUST contain exactly sixteen octets
Conforming CAs MUST include this extension in all CA certificates that contain public keys used to validate digital signatures on certificates
If present, version MUST be v2 or v3
If present, version MUST be v3 -- }
authorityCertIssuer and authorityCertSerialNumber MUST both be present or both be absent
CAs MUST force the serialNumber to be a non-negative integer
Conforming CAs MUST NOT use serialNumber values longer than 20 octets
the sign bit in the DER encoding of the INTEGER value MUST be zero
